title: Certificates of Deposit: in-term add-on limits by tier
content:
## Scope

This card covers the limits on adding money to a certificate of the Certificates of Deposit line during a term, outside the grace period, for every tier.

## Definitions

- **Most add-ons per term** is the most deposits that may be added during a term, outside grace, as a count.
- **Smallest in-term add-on** is the smallest single in-term add-on deposit, in USD, or "not applicable".
- **Most added per term** is the most that may be added in total during one term, outside grace, in USD, or "not applicable".

## Limits by tier

| Tier | Most add-ons per term (outside grace) | Smallest single in-term add-on (USD) | Most added in total per term, outside grace (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 6-Month Certificate | 0 | Not applicable | Not applicable |
| 11-Month No-Penalty Certificate | 0 | Not applicable | Not applicable |
| 12-Month Certificate | 0 | Not applicable | Not applicable |
| 18-Month Bump-Up Certificate | 1 | 100.00 | 25000.00 |
| 36-Month Certificate | 0 | Not applicable | Not applicable |
| 60-Month Certificate | 0 | Not applicable | Not applicable |

## Points of judgement

**Which tier takes new money during a term?**
Only the 18-Month Bump-Up Certificate, which allows 1 add-on per term. Every other tier allows 0 add-ons per term, and its amount limits are not applicable.

**On the 18-Month Bump-Up Certificate, is 25000.00 USD the limit per deposit or per term?**
Per term: it is the most that may be added in total during one term, outside grace. Because the tier allows only 1 add-on per term, that single add-on can be at most 25000.00 USD and at least 100.00 USD.

**Do grace-period deposits count against these limits?**
No. These limits apply during a term, outside the grace period; grace deposits have their own allowances.

## Hypothetical requests on an 18-Month Bump-Up Certificate with no add-on yet this term

| Requested add-on | Meets the smallest add-on? | Within the most added per term? |
|---|---|---|
| 99.99 USD | No | Yes |
| 100.00 USD | Yes | Yes |
| 25000.00 USD | Yes | Yes |
| 25000.01 USD | Yes | No |
